name: golf-play-caddy-vercel
description: SmartCaddie Pro - PGA Tour Grade WebGIS Golf Navigator with Cloud Sync

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','sw.js','manifest.json','icon.svg'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f); }); console.log('Successfully prepared public directory for Vercel');"
